title: salix × seringeana
intro: Salix × seringeana, commonly known as Willow-White Poplar, is a hybrid plant species resulting from the cross-breeding of Salix alba (White Willow) and Populus tremula (Aspen). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer a range of health benefits, including reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Willow-White Poplar are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation and calmness. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to the plant's anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
